You are the implementing engineer for Atlas ERP, in '/Users/taha/Claude projects/expremental ERP/atlas-erp' on branch feat/sales-billing (dev merged; sales 7.1 masters + 7.2 order + 7.3 delivery all present). NO git commands. uv at ~/.local/bin/uv; run `cd backend && ~/.local/bin/uv run <cmd>`. PostgreSQL 16 at postgresql+asyncpg://atlas:atlas@localhost:55432/atlas (LOCAL — run the full pg suite). This is the FINAL Phase 7 task; it completes the sales module and the order-to-cash loop.

READ FIRST (binding): docs/research/s4hana-parity.md SD (billing = PARTIAL "per-delivery invoicing with FI posting + credit notes, no collective billing runs/split-merge/billing plans"; returns = FULL "RMA returns with credit notes"); docs/architecture.md D-045 (the 7.3 delivery posted Dr COGS / Cr Inventory via the event bus — billing now posts the REVENUE side, and a return reverses BOTH), D-029 (the AR customer invoice's customer is the opaque partner_id = the sales customer id; finance OWNS the AR customer invoice — fin_customer_invoices from 4.6), D-011/D-012/D-013/D-014/D-015/D-022/D-025/D-007. Then read the EXACT code you integrate with and MIRROR:
- The 6.4 procurement → finance AP pattern is the CLOSEST precedent (sales billing → finance AR is its mirror): backend/app/modules/procurement/service/invoice_match_post.py (post_invoice_match publishes an event), backend/app/modules/procurement/events.py (the InvoiceMatched event + bill-line payload), backend/app/modules/finance/handlers.py (create_bill_for_match — the finance handler that creates+posts the AP bill from the event; you add the SYMMETRIC create_invoice_for_billing that posts the AR customer invoice).
- finance AR: backend/app/modules/finance/models/receivables.py (CustomerInvoice + lines — the AR doc the handler creates), backend/app/modules/finance/service/ (the create+post customer-invoice entrypoint the handler calls — find it, e.g. service/customer_invoices.py post path: Dr AR control / Cr revenue per line + Cr output tax), finance/queries.py (ar_control account / revenue posting defaults — check what exists; AR control + a 'sales_revenue' posting default may be needed; if a revenue account default doesn't exist, add a 'sales_revenue' posting purpose like 6.4 added 'ap_control'/'purchase_price_variance'), finance/constants posting purposes.
- sales: backend/app/modules/sales/models/ (Delivery/DeliveryLine with delivered_quantity, SalesOrder/Line with invoiced_quantity declared in 7.2, Customer with payment_terms_days), service/delivery_post.py + service/deliveries.py, queries.py (get_order_for_invoice / delivered-not-invoiced — check; so_line open-to-invoice), constants.py, events.py (DeliveryShipped — you ADD billing + return events), the sibling-router mounting, service/__init__.py re-export.
- inventory: service/stock_moves.py (create_move — a RETURN brings goods back as a RECEIPT move; its costing posts a journal; for a customer return the goods re-enter at the ORIGINAL cost and the offset is COGS reversed — Dr Inventory / Cr COGS; use the valuation_offset_account_id override = the COGS account so the return credits COGS, mirroring how 6.3 overrode to GR/IR; OR rely on a RECEIPT default — but RECEIPT default offset is price-difference, so for a customer return you MUST override the offset to the item-category COGS account so COGS is reversed; confirm the override path from 6.3/7.3). inventory/queries (get_category_accounts → cogs account; bin to receive into).
Latest migration = 0030.

CRITICAL §5: sales must NOT import finance/inventory service. Billing → AR invoice goes via the EVENT BUS (sales publishes; finance/handlers.py creates+posts the AR invoice) — mirror 6.4. The return's stock RECEIPT goes via the event bus to inventory/handlers.py (mirror 7.3's DeliveryShipped → ISSUE, but RETURN → RECEIPT with the COGS offset). Verify sales imports only finance/inventory QUERIES + events.

TASK — PLAN 7.4: billing (invoice from delivery → revenue) + RMA returns with credit notes. TWO deliverables:

PART A — Billing (invoice from delivery):
1. sales/constants.py: BillingStatus (DRAFT|POSTED|CANCELLED); permissions sales.billing.read/.manage/.post; sequence 'sales.billing' (the sales billing document number, BIL-… or SI-…; note the FINANCE customer invoice has its OWN INV- number — this is the sales-side billing doc that triggers it); doc type + docflow links delivery→billing and order→billing and billing→customer-invoice (the finance doc). Event key 'sales.billing.posted'.
2. sales/models (models/billing.py; re-export): `SalesBilling` (`sales_billings`): DocumentMixin header; billing_number, status, sales_order_id (composite tenant_fk), customer_id (snapshot), currency_code, billing_date, payment_terms_days (snapshot from customer), total_amount (MoneyType), notes, posted_at. `SalesBillingLine`: line_number, sales_order_line_id (composite tenant_fk), delivery_line_id (nullable composite tenant_fk — which shipment this bills), item_id (snapshot), quantity (QuantityType — billed qty, ≤ delivered-not-invoiced), unit_price (MoneyType — from the order line), discount fields (snapshot), line_amount, tax_code_id (opaque finance tax code, nullable). UNIQUE(tenant, billing_id, line_number).
3. sales/service (service/billing.py + billing_post.py if >400): create_billing(sales_order_id, lines[(so_line_id, delivery_line_id?, qty, tax_code)] OR a "bill all delivered-not-invoiced for this order" convenience) — DRAFT; validate the order is delivered (at least partially), each billed qty ≤ (delivered − already invoiced) for that order line → over-billing 422 sales.over_billing (can't invoice beyond what shipped — the billing-from-delivery constraint), compute line_amount + total, claim billing number, docflow delivery/order→billing. post_billing(billing_id) — in run_in_uow: PUBLISH the billing event; finance/handlers.py creates+posts the AR customer invoice (Dr AR control / Cr sales-revenue per line + Cr output tax; partner_id = customer id, due_date = billing_date + payment_terms, currency); raise the order line invoiced_quantity; advance the order status toward INVOICED/CLOSED (INVOICED when fully invoiced; CLOSED when fully delivered AND invoiced); link docflow billing→customer-invoice (the finance doc); set billing POSTED. Atomic; closed-period billing_date rolls back (the AR invoice's journal period trigger). Idempotent; re-post rejected. cancel DRAFT-only.
4. finance: add a 'sales_revenue' posting default/purpose (the revenue account billing credits) + an 'ar_control' default if not already present (6.4 may have added it — check; reuse) + a finance/queries helper for the revenue account; add the symmetric finance/handlers.create_invoice_for_billing that subscribes to the sales billing event and creates+posts the AR customer invoice via the finance AR service (reuse the existing create+post customer-invoice path — do NOT hand-roll the journal; the AR invoice service already posts Dr AR / Cr revenue / Cr output tax). Register the handler in app.main.register_event_handlers.

PART B — RMA returns with credit notes:
5. sales/constants.py: ReturnStatus (DRAFT|POSTED|CANCELLED); permissions sales.return.read/.manage/.post; sequence 'sales.return' (RMA-/RET-); doc type + docflow links order→return / billing→return / return→stock-move / return→credit-note. Event keys 'sales.return.received' (→ inventory RECEIPT) — actually a return posts BOTH a stock receipt AND a credit note, so you may need one event the inventory handler consumes (RETURN → RECEIPT move at COGS) and one the finance handler consumes (credit note → AR credit memo), OR one richer event both handle. Mirror how you structure billing; document.
6. sales/models (models/returns.py; re-export): `SalesReturn` (`sales_returns`): DocumentMixin header; return_number, status, sales_order_id (composite tenant_fk — the order being returned against; OR billing-based; keep order-based), customer_id (snapshot), warehouse_id (opaque — where returned goods land), currency_code, return_date, reason (str nullable), total_amount (MoneyType — the credit), notes, posted_at. `SalesReturnLine`: line_number, sales_order_line_id (composite tenant_fk), item_id (snapshot), bin_id (opaque — where stock is received), quantity (QuantityType — returned qty, ≤ delivered/invoiced — define the cap: can't return more than was delivered AND invoiced; pick returned ≤ invoiced so a credit note matches a real invoice; document), unit_price (MoneyType — from order/invoice, the credit price), line_amount, lot/serial (nullable), tax_code_id (opaque). UNIQUE(tenant, return_id, line_number).
7. sales/service (service/returns.py + returns_post.py if >400): create_return(sales_order_id, lines[(so_line_id, bin_id, qty, lot/serial, tax_code)], return_date, warehouse) — DRAFT; validate the order/lines were delivered+invoiced, returned qty ≤ invoiced-not-yet-returned (track a returned_quantity on the order line via migration, OR compute from existing returns; prefer a returned_quantity column for the cap — over-return 422 sales.over_return), bin/warehouse exist, claim RMA number, docflow order→return. post_return(return_id) — in run_in_uow: PUBLISH the return event(s) — inventory/handlers.py creates a RECEIPT move per line (goods back into the bin, valuation_offset_account_id = the item-category COGS account so the return posts Dr Inventory / Cr COGS, REVERSING the original issue's COGS) AND finance/handlers.py creates+posts an AR CREDIT NOTE (a customer credit memo: Dr sales-revenue / Cr AR control + reverse output tax — the credit note reduces what the customer owes; reuse the finance AR credit-note path if one exists from 4.6 RMA hooks, else the AR invoice service with a credit/negative flag — check finance for a credit-memo entrypoint; if absent, the cleanest is the AR invoice service posting the reversing journal — coordinate with finance's existing AR model: a credit note is a CustomerInvoice with a CREDIT_NOTE document type or a negative amount; mirror however finance modeled credit notes in 4.6, and if 4.6 didn't, add a minimal credit-note path in finance and call it via the handler). Raise the order line returned_quantity; advance the return POSTED; link docflow return→stock-move + return→credit-note. Atomic; closed-period rolls back. Idempotent. cancel DRAFT-only.
   - IMPORTANT: re-read finance 4.6 (receivables) to see if credit notes already exist (dunning/credit-note). Use the existing mechanism; only add what's missing. Document the credit-note posting (Dr revenue / Cr AR, reverse tax).
8. sales/queries: get_billing, billings_for_order, so_line_open_to_invoice (delivered − invoiced); get_return, returns_for_order, so_line_open_to_return (invoiced − returned). The only imported file.
9. sales/router: billing_router + return_router siblings (mounted into router.py): billing CRUD + post + cancel; returns CRUD + post + cancel. Permission-guard (manage vs post). Paginated lists. PERFORMANCE §6. Mount.
10. Migration 0031_sales_billing_returns.py (down_revision 0030): sales_billings + lines + sales_returns + lines + the invoiced_quantity already exists on the order line (7.2)? + a returned_quantity column on sales_order_lines (batch_alter) + indexes. No trigger-bearing alters.
11. docs/modules/sales.md: billing section (invoice-from-delivery → AR via event bus mirroring 6.4, the revenue posting, over-billing constraint, order→INVOICED/CLOSED) + returns section (RMA → stock receipt reversing COGS + credit note reversing revenue, the over-return cap, atomic). DECISIONS.md D-046 (billing → AR invoice via event bus; the order-to-cash GL: delivery Dr COGS/Cr Inv, billing Dr AR/Cr Revenue; return reverses both; over-billing ≤ delivered, over-return ≤ invoiced).
12. Tests: test_billing.py + test_billing_api.py (create from delivered order, over-billing 422, post → finance AR customer invoice exists Dr AR / Cr Revenue + tax, order invoiced_quantity raised + status INVOICED/CLOSED, docflow order→delivery→billing→invoice, closed-period rollback, idempotent, RBAC, isolation, budgets); test_returns.py + test_returns_api.py (create against an invoiced order, over-return 422, post → inventory RECEIPT move (on-hand UP) reversing COGS (Dr Inventory / Cr COGS) AND an AR credit note (Dr Revenue / Cr AR), order returned_quantity raised, docflow, closed-period rollback, idempotent, RBAC, isolation). 
   - The KEY end-to-end O2C proof: order → confirm → deliver (Dr COGS/Cr Inv) → bill (Dr AR/Cr Rev) → the AR account holds the receivable, revenue recognized, inventory reduced, COGS recognized; then a full return reverses all of it (inventory back, COGS back, revenue back, AR back) → the accounts net to zero. Assert via the finance account-balance/trial-balance query (mirror the 6.4 GR/IR-clears-to-zero test). This is the headline test.
   - HEED issue #53: do NOT assert state on the SAME session after an expected POST failure caused by a handler-raised exception (insufficient stock etc.); use create-time 422s for the rejection cases and assert happy-path success + state otherwise (the 7.3 test_deliveries.py pattern).

RULES: no TODO/stub/dead-file; absolute imports; ruff + pytest FULLY green SQLite (`-m "not pg and not perf"`) AND `-m pg` (reset pg schema, alembic upgrade head, run -m pg); delete stray atlas.db; EVERY file <400 lines (packages/sibling-routers from the start); comments only non-obvious; don't print file contents. Update PROGRESS.md + tick PLAN 7.4 (note Phase 7 / Sales COMPLETE) + DECISIONS.md D-046. Run STRUCTURE §9 self-check (esp. §5) and report it.

Return: files created/changed, the billing→AR + return→(stock+credit-note) event mechanisms + §5 verification, the O2C GL postings (delivery/billing/return), the over-billing (≤delivered) + over-return (≤invoiced) constraints, how credit notes are modeled in finance (existing vs added), the end-to-end-nets-to-zero proof, test counts (SQLite total+new, pg), migration number, §9 self-check, deviations.

1	# SAP S/4HANA → Atlas Parity Map
2	
3	This document benchmarks Atlas ERP against SAP S/4HANA, the de-facto reference for enterprise ERP scope. Its purpose is twofold: to define what "complete" means for each functional area by enumerating the capabilities practitioners consider essential in current S/4HANA (2025/2026 releases), and to record — capability by capability — what Atlas v1 implements in full, what it implements in reduced form, and what it deliberately leaves out. The Atlas v1 scope is derived directly from this benchmark: every cut is documented with its rationale and an intended later path, so the gaps are commitments, not omissions. Research for this map was conducted in June 2026.
4	
5	**Methodology.** All twelve functional areas below were verified through live web research against current sources (SAP Help Portal, SAP Learning, SAP Community, SAP PRESS, and ERP consulting publications); no area was built from the embedded knowledge baseline alone. Five areas — Financial Accounting, Inventory Management & Warehousing, Quality Management & Plant Maintenance, Project System, and Cross-cutting platform concepts — supplemented web findings with embedded S/4HANA knowledge for specific subtopics or where source pages could not be fetched; these are flagged in the Sources appendix.
6	
7	Reading the tables: capabilities that practitioners consider **essential** are shown in bold. The Notes column preserves, verbatim, the scoping rationale and the planned later path for every partial and out-of-scope capability — that record is the contract of this document.

11	## Mandatory design inheritances
12	
13	Two S/4HANA architectural principles are hardcoded into Atlas and are non-negotiable across all modules:
14	
15	1. **Universal Journal pattern.** Atlas maintains one append-only financial line-item table as the single source of truth for all accounting data — the analogue of S/4HANA's ACDOCA. Every FI and CO view (trial balance, cost center report, margin analysis, financial statements) is a projection over this table. Totals are never separately stored; there are no aggregate tables to reconcile, and FI/CO reconciliation is eliminated by construction.
16	
17	2. **Document flow.** Every business document in Atlas records its predecessor and successor links (quote → order → delivery → invoice → journal entry, requisition → PO → goods receipt → supplier invoice, and so on), and the UI can render the full chain from any document in either direction — the analogue of S/4HANA's document flow and Document Relationship Browser.

41	## Financial Accounting (FI)
42	
43	SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting centers on the Universal Journal (table ACDOCA), which merges general ledger, controlling, asset, and material-ledger line items into one multi-dimensional single source of truth, eliminating FI/CO reconciliation. Around that core sit Accounts Payable (vendor invoices, automatic payment runs), Accounts Receivable (customer invoices, dunning, incoming payments), Asset Accounting (ledger-based parallel valuation and depreciation), Bank and Cash Management, tax determination via tax codes and procedures, real-time financial statements drawn directly from the journal, and orchestrated period-end/year-end close. Distinctive S/4HANA traits practitioners flag as essential include parallel ledgers for multi-GAAP accounting, document splitting for dimension-complete balance sheets, up to 10 parallel currencies, and posting-period control.

62	## Controlling (CO)
63	
64	In current S/4HANA, Controlling is no longer a separate ledger world: FI and CO are merged into the Universal Journal (ACDOCA), so every posting carries cost center, profit center, project/WBS, order, and profitability-segment dimensions, and all CO reporting is a real-time projection of that single table; cost elements have become G/L accounts. The practitioner-essential core comprises cost center accounting, profit center accounting, internal orders (deprecated in S/4HANA Cloud in favor of project cost collectors), product cost planning and cost object controlling, Margin Analysis (account-based CO-PA), universal allocations, activity types with internal activity allocation, and cost center planning/budgeting, with Material Ledger actual costing as an optional deepening. Atlas v1's design matches the architectural core and S/4HANA Cloud's direction (including replacing internal orders with projects), but leaves activity-rate machinery, planning/budgeting, variance decomposition, and multi-dimensional margin segments for later.

82	## Procurement (MM-PUR)
83	
84	In current S/4HANA (2025/2026), Sourcing and Procurement covers the full procure-to-pay cycle: business-partner-based supplier master data, purchasing info records, purchase requisitions (now with Fiori self-service apps), RFQs and quotation comparison, purchase orders, goods receipt, and logistics invoice verification with 3-way match, tolerances, and payment blocking. Approvals run through either classic classification-based release strategies or the newer flexible workflow. Framework agreements (quantity/value contracts, scheduling agreements), source determination, and supplier evaluation round out the area; certification weightings confirm master data, the PR-to-PO process, and GR/invoice verification as the practitioner-essential core. Atlas v1 plans the essential discrete P2P chain end-to-end but deliberately defers outline agreements, automated source assignment, and supplier evaluation.

103	## Inventory Management & Warehousing (MM-IM / EWM)
104	
105	In current S/4HANA (2025), MM-IM covers the material/product master, all goods movements recorded in the unified MATDOC table, stock types and special stocks, physical inventory with cycle counting, and material valuation through the now-mandatory Material Ledger (standard price, moving average, FIFO/balance-sheet valuation), plus batch and serial number management and reorder-point replenishment. Warehousing is handled by embedded or decentralized EWM, whose basic tier covers storage-type/bin structures, putaway and stock-removal strategies, and handling units, while waves, slotting, labor management and MFS sit in the advanced (separately licensed) tier. Atlas v1 covers the transactional inventory core well (moves as single source of truth, MAV+FIFO costing, counts, lot/serial, reorder points) but deliberately stops short of stock-status/special-stock dimensions, standard costing, and the EWM execution layer.

123	## Sales & Distribution (SD)
124	
125	In current S/4HANA (2025/2026), Sales covers the full order-to-cash cycle: business-partner-based customer master, condition-technique pricing, pre-sales documents and contracts, sales order processing, (advanced) available-to-promise with backorder processing, outbound delivery and goods issue, billing with FI integration, FSCM-based credit management, and Advanced Returns Management, plus condition contract settlement (rebates), output management, intercompany/third-party flows, and Fiori-based fulfillment monitoring. 144	## Production Planning (PP)
145	
146	S/4HANA PP covers manufacturing master data (material master, multi-level BOMs, work centers, routings, production versions), demand management with planning strategies and planned independent requirements, MRP including the in-memory MRP Live engine, production order execution with shop floor control and confirmations, and capacity evaluation/leveling. It additionally ships lean/order-less execution models (kanban, repetitive manufacturing), process-industry variants (PP-PI), and embedded PP/DS for finite detailed scheduling and optimization. Atlas v1's plan covers the discrete-manufacturing core well (BOMs, work centers, routings, production orders with WIP accounting, a deterministic MRP run, rough capacity check) while deliberately omitting forecast-based demand management, operation-level confirmations, capacity leveling, kanban, repetitive manufacturing, PP-PI, and PP/DS-class finite scheduling — the same areas v1-grade systems typically defer.

165	## Quality Management & Plant Maintenance (QM / PM-EAM)
166

208	
209	S/4HANA Project System manages internal, capital-investment, and customer projects through hierarchical work breakdown structures (WBS) and optional networks/activities, covering structure planning, scheduling, cost and revenue planning, budgeting with availability control, execution postings (time via CATS, procurement, goods movements), and period-end close via settlement and results analysis / event-based revenue recognition. 228	## Cross-cutting platform concepts
229	
230	Cross-cutting platform concepts in S/4HANA (2025/2026) are the architectural primitives every functional module relies on: the Universal Journal (ACDOCA) as the single financial line-item table; document flow with predecessor/successor links viewable in the Document Relationship Browser; the mandatory unified Business Partner model (CVI-synchronized customer/vendor views); the BRF+/Adobe Forms output management framework; configurable number ranges per document type; the roles/profiles authorization concept (PFCG on-premise, business roles with restrictions in Cloud); and the client (MANDT) field on nearly every table on-premise, replaced by tenant isolation in S/4HANA Cloud SaaS. Atlas v1 deliberately inherits the two load-bearing patterns (Universal Journal, document flow) and covers tenancy, RBAC, audit, and numbering, while consciously deviating on the Business Partner model and deferring output management, workflow, and extensibility.

269	## Industry Solutions approach
270	
271	SAP's S/4HANA industry approach folded most former IS add-ons into a single codebase ("industry to core"), covering roughly 25 industries whose functionality is activated per system through business function sets and the switch framework — activation is largely irreversible, one industry function set per instance, and industry-specific LoB functions are licensed separately from the Enterprise Management core. What the industry layer actually varies is substantial: terminology (Article vs Material, Site vs Plant), industry master data models (retail article/site, patient, equipment), entire vertical process suites (merchandise management, EC&O Equipment & Tools Management, professional-services Commercial Project Management, IS-U billing), regulatory content, and preconfigured SAP Best Practices content applied at setup. The current 2025/2026 direction adds a clean-core posture where deep vertical needs increasingly move to SAP Industry Cloud partner extensions on BTP — notably SAP is discontinuing healthcare IS-H by 2030 in favor of partner solutions. Atlas v1's YAML template layer maps well to the configuration-content slice of this area but plans none of the vertical process logic, industry master data objects, regulatory content, or partner extension ecosystem that practitioners associate with SAP industry solutions.

1	"""3-way invoice-match post / override / cancel (PLAN 6.4, D-042), split from ``invoice_matches.py``
2	at the 400-line cap (the goods_receipts writes/reads precedent). The create path + its validation
3	helpers + the shared ``po_lines_for`` stay in ``invoice_matches.py``; the state-transition actions
4	live here. Re-exported with create + reads from the package ``__init__`` as one ``service`` surface.
5	
6	``post_invoice_match`` is the heart: in ONE transaction it raises each PO line's billed_quantity,
7	advances the PO toward CLOSED, links docflow PO→match + GR→match, sets the match POSTED, and
8	PUBLISHES ``InvoiceMatched`` so finance's handler creates + posts the AP vendor bill (Dr GR/IR at PO
9	cost +
10	Dr/Cr PPV / Cr AP at the invoiced total), clearing the GR/IR account the goods receipt credited at
11	receipt — the procure-to-pay loop closes. A closed invoice period trips the bill's journal trigger
12	and rolls it ALL back.
13	"""
14	
15	from __future__ import annotations
16	
17	import uuid
18	from datetime import datetime, timedelta
19	from decimal import Decimal
20	
21	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
22	
23	from app.core import docflow
24	from app.core.events import publish
25	from app.core.exceptions import ConflictError
26	from app.core.money import quantize_for_currency
27	from app.modules.finance import queries as finance_queries
28	from app.modules.procurement import queries as procurement_queries
29	from app.modules.procurement.constants import (
30	    GR_MATCHED_BY_INVOICE_MATCH_LINK,
31	    PO_MATCHED_BY_INVOICE_MATCH_LINK,
32	    MatchStatus,
33	    PurchaseOrderStatus,
34	)
35	from app.modules.procurement.events import InvoiceMatchBillLine, InvoiceMatched
36	from app.modules.procurement.models import (
37	    GoodsReceiptLine,
38	    InvoiceMatch,
39	    InvoiceMatchLine,
40	    PurchaseOrder,
41	)
42	from app.modules.procurement.service.invoice_match_reads import (
43	    get_invoice_match,
44	    get_invoice_match_lines,
45	)
46	from app.modules.procurement.service.invoice_matches import po_lines_for

49	async def override_invoice_match(
50	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, match_id: uuid.UUID
51	) -> InvoiceMatch:
52	    """Clear an EXCEPTION so the match may post (PLAN 6.4 — the invoice-release control). Only an
53	    EXCEPTION match can be overridden; it moves to MATCHED. An authorized user accepting the price
54	    difference is recorded via the audited status change (procurement.invoice_match.manage)."""
55	    match = await get_invoice_match(session, tenant_id, match_id)
56	    if MatchStatus(match.status) != MatchStatus.EXCEPTION:
57	        raise ConflictError(
58	            message="Only a match in EXCEPTION can be overridden",
59	            code="procurement.match_not_exception",
60	            details={"status": match.status},
61	        )
62	    match.status = MatchStatus.MATCHED.value
63	    await session.flush()
64	    await docflow.set_document_status(
65	        session, tenant_id, match.document_id, status=MatchStatus.MATCHED.value
66	    )
67	    return match
68	
69	
70	async def cancel_invoice_match(
71	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, match_id: uuid.UUID
72	) -> InvoiceMatch:
73	    """Cancel a DRAFT/MATCHED/EXCEPTION match before posting (PLAN 6.4). A POSTED match is TERMINAL
74	    — it triggered an AP bill, so it is corrected by a credit memo / reversal (Phase 7), never
75	    cancelled. Cancelling raises no bill and changes no billed_quantity."""
76	    match = await get_invoice_match(session, tenant_id, match_id)
77	    if MatchStatus(match.status) in (MatchStatus.POSTED, MatchStatus.CANCELLED):
78	        raise ConflictError(
79	            message=f"A {match.status} invoice match cannot be cancelled",
80	            code="procurement.match_not_cancellable",
81	            details={"status": match.status},
82	        )
83	    match.status = MatchStatus.CANCELLED.value
84	    await session.flush()
85	    await docflow.set_document_status(
86	        session, tenant_id, match.document_id, status=MatchStatus.CANCELLED.value
87	    )
88	    return match
89	
90	
91	def _require_postable(match: InvoiceMatch, match_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
92	    """Only a MATCHED match can post: a POSTED one is terminal, an EXCEPTION must be overridden
93	    first, any other state is not postable (PLAN 6.4)."""
94	    status = MatchStatus(match.status)
95	    if status == MatchStatus.POSTED:
96	        raise ConflictError(
97	            message="The invoice match is already posted",
98	            code="procurement.match_already_posted",
99	            details={"invoice_match_id": str(match_id)},
100	        )
101	    if status == MatchStatus.EXCEPTION:
102	        raise ConflictError(
103	            message="A match in EXCEPTION must be overridden before it can be posted",
104	            code="procurement.match_in_exception",
105	            details={"invoice_match_id": str(match_id)},
106	        )
107	    if status != MatchStatus.MATCHED:
108	        raise ConflictError(
109	            message=f"A {match.status} invoice match cannot be posted",
110	            code="procurement.match_not_postable",
111	            details={"invoice_match_id": str(match_id), "status": match.status},
112	        )
113	
114	
115	async def post_invoice_match(
116	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, match_id: uuid.UUID
117	) -> InvoiceMatch:
118	    """Post a MATCHED invoice match (PLAN 6.4, D-042) — the heart. In ONE transaction: raise each PO
119	    line's billed_quantity, advance the PO toward CLOSED (fully received AND billed), link docflow
120	    PO→match + GR→match, set the match POSTED, and PUBLISH ``InvoiceMatched`` so finance's handler
121	    creates + posts the AP vendor bill (Dr GR/IR at PO cost + Dr/Cr PPV / Cr AP at the invoiced
122	    total), clearing the GR/IR account the goods receipt credited at receipt — the procure-to-pay
123	    loop closes. A closed invoice period trips the bill's journal trigger and rolls it ALL back.
124	
125	    Only a MATCHED match can post (an EXCEPTION must be overridden first). A POSTED match is
126	    idempotent-rejected (terminal). The caller commits via uow; the event drains in the same uow."""
127	    match = await get_invoice_match(session, tenant_id, match_id)
128	    _require_postable(match, match_id)
129	
130	    # Resolve the PPV + AP accounts and the vendor terms up front (downward reads) — raises 422 if a
131	    # tenant has not mapped them, so the post fails before any state change (D-042).
132	    ppv_account_id = await finance_queries.purchase_price_variance_account(session, tenant_id)
133	    ap_account_id = await finance_queries.ap_control_account(session, tenant_id)
134	    terms_days = (
135	        await procurement_queries.vendor_payment_terms_days(session, tenant_id, match.vendor_id)
136	        or 0
137	    )
138	    vendor = await procurement_queries.get_vendor(session, tenant_id, match.vendor_id)
139	    partner_name = vendor.name if vendor is not None else ""
140	
141	    lines = await get_invoice_match_lines(session, tenant_id, match_id)
142	    po_lines = {
143	        line.id: line for line in await po_lines_for(session, tenant_id, match.purchase_order_id)
144	    }
145	
146	    bill_lines = _raise_billed_and_build_bill_lines(match, lines, po_lines)
147	    await _advance_po_status(session, tenant_id, match.purchase_order_id, po_lines.values())
148	
149	    match.status = MatchStatus.POSTED.value
150	    match.posted_at = datetime.now()
151	    await session.flush()
152	    await docflow.set_document_status(
153	        session, tenant_id, match.document_id, status=MatchStatus.POSTED.value
154	    )
155	    await _link_match_predecessors(session, tenant_id, match, lines)
156	
157	    publish(
158	        session,
159	        InvoiceMatched(
160	            tenant_id=tenant_id,
161	            match_id=match.id,
162	            match_number=match.match_number,
163	            document_id=match.document_id,
164	            partner_id=match.vendor_id,
165	            partner_name=partner_name,
166	            vendor_invoice_ref=match.vendor_invoice_ref,
167	            invoice_date=match.invoice_date,
168	            due_date=match.invoice_date + timedelta(days=terms_days),
169	            currency_code=match.currency_code,
170	            gr_ir_account_id=match.gr_ir_account_id,
171	            ppv_account_id=ppv_account_id,
172	            ap_account_id=ap_account_id,
173	            tax_code_id=match.tax_code_id,
174	            lines=tuple(bill_lines),
175	        ),
176	    )
177	    return match
178	
179	
180	def _raise_billed_and_build_bill_lines(
181	    match: InvoiceMatch,
182	    lines: list[InvoiceMatchLine],
183	    po_lines: dict[uuid.UUID, object],
184	) -> list[InvoiceMatchBillLine]:
185	    """Raise each PO line's billed_quantity by its matched quantity and build the per-line bill
186	    payload finance's handler posts: the GR/IR portion at PO cost + the price variance + the
187	    invoiced net (PLAN 6.4). The PO lines are mutated in-session."""
188	    bill_lines: list[InvoiceMatchBillLine] = []
189	    for line in lines:
190	        po_line = po_lines[line.purchase_order_line_id]
191	        po_line.billed_quantity = Decimal(str(po_line.billed_quantity)) + Decimal(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
192	            str(line.matched_quantity)
193	        )
194	        gr_ir_amount = quantize_for_currency(
195	            Decimal(str(line.matched_quantity)) * Decimal(str(line.po_unit_cost)),
196	            match.currency_code,
197	        )
198	        bill_lines.append(
199	            InvoiceMatchBillLine(
200	                item_id=line.item_id,
201	                gr_ir_amount=gr_ir_amount,
202	                price_variance=Decimal(str(line.price_variance)),
203	                net_amount=Decimal(str(line.line_amount)),
204	            )
205	        )
206	    return bill_lines
207	
208	
209	async def _link_match_predecessors(
210	    session: AsyncSession,
211	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
212	    match: InvoiceMatch,
213	    lines: list[InvoiceMatchLine],
214	) -> None:
215	    """Link the match's predecessor documents (PLAN 6.4): PO → 'matched_by' → match, and each
216	    distinct goods receipt feeding the match → 'matched_by' → match. The match → bill edge is
217	    written by finance's handler when it posts the bill (D-042)."""
218	    po = await session.get(PurchaseOrder, match.purchase_order_id)
219	    if po is not None:
220	        await docflow.link_documents(
221	            session,
222	            tenant_id,
223	            predecessor=po.document_id,
224	            successor=match.document_id,
225	            link_type=PO_MATCHED_BY_INVOICE_MATCH_LINK,
226	        )
227	    linked_grs: set[uuid.UUID] = set()
228	    for line in lines:
229	        if line.goods_receipt_line_id is None:
230	            continue
231	        gr_line = await session.get(GoodsReceiptLine, line.goods_receipt_line_id)
232	        if gr_line is None or gr_line.gr_id in linked_grs:
233	            continue
234	        gr = await procurement_queries.get_goods_receipt(session, tenant_id, gr_line.gr_id)
235	        if gr is not None:
236	            await docflow.link_documents(
237	                session,
238	                tenant_id,
239	                predecessor=gr.document_id,
240	                successor=match.document_id,
241	                link_type=GR_MATCHED_BY_INVOICE_MATCH_LINK,
242	            )
243	            linked_grs.add(gr_line.gr_id)
244	
245	
246	async def _advance_po_status(
247	    session: AsyncSession,
248	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
249	    po_id: uuid.UUID,
250	    po_lines,
251	) -> None:
252	    """Advance the PO to CLOSED when every line is fully RECEIVED and fully BILLED (PLAN 6.4): the
253	    procure-to-pay end state. Otherwise the PO stays where the receipt left it (PARTIALLY_RECEIVED /
254	    RECEIVED) — more goods or invoices are outstanding. The lines are already mutated in-session."""
255	    fully_billed = all(
256	        Decimal(str(line.received_quantity)) >= Decimal(str(line.quantity))
257	        and Decimal(str(line.billed_quantity)) >= Decimal(str(line.quantity))
258	        for line in po_lines
259	    )
260	    if not fully_billed:
261	        return
262	    po = await session.get(PurchaseOrder, po_id)
263	    if po is None or po.tenant_id != tenant_id:
264	        return
265	    po.status = PurchaseOrderStatus.CLOSED.value
266	    await session.flush()
267	    await docflow.set_document_status(
268	        session, tenant_id, po.document_id, status=PurchaseOrderStatus.CLOSED.value
269	    )

1	"""Domain events procurement PUBLISHES (D-011/D-041). Declarative data only — no logic, no models —
2	so inventory's ``handlers.py`` may import these typed classes (the STRUCTURE §5 events.py allowance:
3	an event carries no behaviour, so a subscriber in another module imports it without any logic).
4	
5	``GoodsReceiptPosted`` is the SANCTIONED cross-module mechanism for the goods-receipt → stock-move
6	effect (D-041). Procurement OWNS the GR document and its PO; it MUST NOT call inventory's service
7	directly (STRUCTURE §5 forbids importing another module's service). So the GR POST publishes this
8	event carrying everything inventory needs to create the stock RECEIPT moves — one
9	``GoodsReceiptMove`` per GR line (item, target bin, quantity, the snapshot unit cost, lot/serial,
10	the GR/IR
11	clearing offset account, the inspection flag) plus the move_date and the GR's core_documents id for
12	docflow linkage. Inventory's ``handlers.py`` subscribes, creates each move via its OWN service with
13	``valuation_offset_account_id`` = the GR/IR account (so the costing event credits GR/IR), and links
14	GR document → 'moved_by' → move document. The handler shares the session, so the moves + their
15	inventory-debit/GR-IR journals land in the SAME transaction as the GR post — all-or-nothing
16	(D-011/D-020): a closed period or any handler failure rolls the WHOLE GR post back.
17	
18	Procurement updates its OWN tables (the PO received_quantity, the GR status/posted_at) in that same
19	transaction AFTER publishing; it does NOT need the move ids back — the GR↔move link is the durable
20	docflow edge the handler writes, not a cross-module FK column (D-041).
21	"""
22	
23	import uuid
24	from datetime import date
25	from decimal import Decimal
26	from typing import ClassVar
27	
28	from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict
29	
30	from app.core.events import DomainEvent
31	from app.modules.procurement.constants import (
32	    GOODS_RECEIPT_POSTED_EVENT_KEY,
33	    INVOICE_MATCHED_EVENT_KEY,
34	)
35	
36	
37	class GoodsReceiptMove(BaseModel):
38	    """One GR line's worth of stock to receive (D-041), the payload inventory's handler turns into a
39	    stock RECEIPT move. Plain frozen data: the opaque item + target bin ids (D-029), the received
40	    quantity in the item's base UoM, the snapshot unit cost the stock enters at, optional lot/serial
41	    codes (created on the receipt for tracked items), and the v1 ``requires_inspection`` flag
42	    (passed through for traceability — Phase 9 adds the disposition; v1 does not block use)."""
43	
44	    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)
45	
46	    item_id: uuid.UUID
47	    bin_id: uuid.UUID
48	    quantity: Decimal
49	    unit_cost: Decimal
50	    lot_code: str | None = None
51	    serial_code: str | None = None
52	    requires_inspection: bool = False
53	
54	
55	class GoodsReceiptPosted(DomainEvent):
56	    """A goods receipt was posted (D-041). Inventory's ``handlers.py`` subscribes and creates one
57	    stock RECEIPT move per ``move`` in the SAME transaction, offsetting each to ``gr_ir_account_id``
58	    (Dr Inventory / Cr GR-IR), and links the GR document to each move document ('moved_by').
59	
60	    - ``goods_receipt_id`` + ``gr_number`` + ``document_id`` — the GR document (``document_id`` is
61	      the core_documents id the handler links the move documents to).
62	    - ``warehouse_id`` — the inventory warehouse the receipt's stock lands in (each move's bin is in
63	      it); carried for context / future per-warehouse routing.
64	    - ``move_date`` — the receipt date the stock moves post on (ISO date string); a date in a CLOSED
65	      period makes each move's valuation journal trip the period trigger, rolling the whole GR back.
66	    - ``gr_ir_account_id`` — the tenant's GR/IR clearing account (resolved by procurement from
67	      finance/queries before publishing); the valuation-offset OVERRIDE every move carries.
68	    - ``moves`` — the per-line receipts (see ``GoodsReceiptMove``)."""
69	
70	    key: ClassVar[str] = GOODS_RECEIPT_POSTED_EVENT_KEY
71	
72	    goods_receipt_id: uuid.UUID
73	    gr_number: str
74	    document_id: uuid.UUID
75	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID
76	    move_date: str
77	    gr_ir_account_id: uuid.UUID
78	    moves: tuple[GoodsReceiptMove, ...]
79	
80	
81	class InvoiceMatchBillLine(BaseModel):
82	    """One match line's worth of bill posting (D-042), the payload finance's handler turns into a
83	    vendor-bill line. Plain frozen data carrying the GL-account routing the matched bill needs:
84	
85	    - ``gr_ir_amount`` — the GR/IR clearing portion at PO COST (matched_quantity × po_unit_cost).
86	      This is what the goods receipt CREDITED GR/IR at receipt; the bill DEBITS exactly this so
87	      GR/IR clears to zero (the accounting subtlety of the 3-way match).
88	    - ``price_variance`` — (unit_price − po_unit_cost) × matched_quantity. The difference between
89	      the vendor's invoiced price and the PO price, routed to the purchase-price-variance account so
90	      GR/IR still clears at PO cost. Positive = the vendor charged MORE than PO (Dr PPV, an extra
91	      cost); negative = LESS (Cr PPV, a saving).
92	    - ``net_amount`` — the line's invoiced net (gr_ir_amount + price_variance = matched_quantity ×
93	      unit_price), the basis the input tax is computed on for this line.
94	    - ``item_id`` — the opaque inventory item, carried as the bill line's dimension (D-017)."""
95	
96	    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)
97	
98	    item_id: uuid.UUID
99	    gr_ir_amount: Decimal
100	    price_variance: Decimal
101	    net_amount: Decimal
102	
103	
104	class InvoiceMatched(DomainEvent):
105	    """A 3-way invoice match was posted (D-042). Finance's ``handlers.py`` subscribes and creates +
106	    POSTS the AP vendor bill in the SAME transaction: Dr GR/IR (the received-goods portion at PO
107	    cost) + Dr/Cr purchase-price-variance (the in-tolerance price difference) + Dr input tax / Cr AP
108	    control at the vendor-invoiced total, with the opaque ``partner_id`` on the AP line (D-029). The
109	    bill clears the GR/IR account the goods receipt credited at receipt — closing the procure-to-pay
110	    loop. Finance handles its OWN bill posting; procurement only PUBLISHES the event (it must not
111	    import finance/service — STRUCTURE §5).
112	
113	    - ``match_id`` + ``match_number`` + ``document_id`` — the match document (``document_id`` is the
114	      core_documents id finance links the bill document to, via the 'billed_by' edge).
115	    - ``partner_id`` + ``partner_name`` — the vendor (the opaque finance partner_id, D-029) + name.
116	    - ``vendor_invoice_ref`` — the vendor's own invoice number, stored as the bill's external ref.
117	    - ``invoice_date`` + ``due_date`` — the bill's date + due date (procurement computes the due
118	      date = invoice_date + the vendor's payment terms, read from procurement's own master).
119	    - ``currency_code`` — the bill's transaction currency (the PO/match currency).
120	    - ``gr_ir_account_id`` — the GR/IR clearing account the bill debits (resolved from finance by
121	      procurement before publishing).
122	    - ``ppv_account_id`` — the purchase-price-variance account any price difference routes to.
123	    - ``ap_account_id`` — the AP control account the bill credits at the invoiced total.
124	    - ``tax_code_id`` — the opaque finance tax code (nullable) driving the input tax.
125	    - ``lines`` — the per-match-line bill postings (see ``InvoiceMatchBillLine``)."""
126	
127	    key: ClassVar[str] = INVOICE_MATCHED_EVENT_KEY
128	
129	    match_id: uuid.UUID
130	    match_number: str
131	    document_id: uuid.UUID
132	    partner_id: uuid.UUID
133	    partner_name: str
134	    vendor_invoice_ref: str | None
135	    invoice_date: date
136	    due_date: date
137	    currency_code: str
138	    gr_ir_account_id: uuid.UUID
139	    ppv_account_id: uuid.UUID
140	    ap_account_id: uuid.UUID
141	    tax_code_id: uuid.UUID | None
142	    lines: tuple[InvoiceMatchBillLine, ...]
143	
144	
145	__all__ = [
146	    "GoodsReceiptMove",
147	    "GoodsReceiptPosted",
148	    "InvoiceMatchBillLine",
149	    "InvoiceMatched",
150	]

1	"""Finance domain-event handlers (D-011) — cross-module subscribers (PLAN 5.3 / 6.4).
2	
3	``post_stock_valuation_journal`` (PLAN 5.3, D-020) subscribes to ``inventory.stock.valued`` and
4	posts the COGS/inventory valuation journal in the SAME transaction as the stock move (D-011
5	run_in_uow drains before commit; D-020 same-transaction COGS). Because the handler shares the
6	session and any handler exception rolls the WHOLE transaction back, a stock move can never commit
7	without its journal entry, or vice versa — the load-bearing atomicity invariant. The journal posts
8	with the move's ``move_date``: a date in a CLOSED period makes the journal's period trigger fire
9	inside this same transaction, which rolls the whole move back (you cannot move stock into a closed
10	accounting period — correct by construction).
11	
12	``create_bill_for_match`` (PLAN 6.4, D-042) subscribes to ``procurement.invoice_match.matched`` and
13	creates + posts the AP vendor bill (Dr GR/IR at PO cost + Dr/Cr purchase-price-variance for the
14	in-tolerance price difference + Dr input tax / Cr AP control at the vendor-invoiced total) in the
15	SAME transaction as the match post. Procurement PUBLISHES the event; finance handles its OWN bill
16	posting (procurement must not import finance/service — STRUCTURE §5). The bill DEBITS GR/IR at
17	exactly the cost the goods receipt CREDITED it at receipt, so the GR/IR clearing account nets to
18	zero — the procure-to-pay loop closes. A closed invoice period trips the bill's journal period
19	trigger here and rolls the whole match post back.
20	
21	Postings per move type (the GL effect of each — D-020). The costing engine pre-selects the OFFSET
22	account per type and the event carries it, so the handler is a thin Dr/Cr direction switch:
23	- RECEIPT / ADJUSTMENT-up: Dr inventory / Cr price-difference. A STANDALONE receipt (opening
24	  balance, manual stock-in) has no procurement GR clearing yet, so its offset is price-difference /
25	  inventory-adjustment account; procurement's goods-receipt path (6.x) will OVERRIDE this with its
26	  own GR/IR offset. ADJUSTMENT-up is the same shape (a stock increase with no document behind it).
27	- ISSUE: Dr COGS / Cr inventory at the computed cost (goods left for sale/production).
28	- ADJUSTMENT-down: Dr price-difference / Cr inventory (an inventory write-off, no document).
29	- The moving-average zero-quantity FLUSH posts its residual to price-difference WITHIN the issue's
30	  entry so value and quantity never disagree (D-020).
31	- A reversal posts the EXACT reverse of the original move's entry (reversing an issue credits COGS;
32	  reversing a receipt debits price-difference) — the costing engine sets the reversal's offset.
33	- TRANSFER within one inventory account: value-neutral → the inventory engine publishes NO event, so
34	  the handler never runs for it (documented; no journal).
35	
36	The journal is built through the finance posting service (``create_draft_entry`` + ``post_entry``),
37	NEVER raw inserts, so every journal invariant (balance, one-side CHECK, period, immutability,
38	numbering, audit, docflow) fires exactly as for any posting. The move's document is linked to the
39	journal entry's document ('posts' edge) so the docflow viewer shows move -> COGS entry.
40	
41	Registration: ``app.main.register_event_handlers`` subscribes ``post_stock_valuation_journal`` to
42	the
43	event key at the app factory (the deterministic D-011 registration seam), so the test harness can
44	re-register after its per-test ``clear_subscriptions`` reset (D-025) without a module re-import.
45	"""
46	
47	from __future__ import annotations
48	
49	import uuid
50	from datetime import date
51	from decimal import Decimal
52	
53	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
54	
55	from app.core import docflow
56	from app.core.money import quantize_for_currency
57	from app.modules.finance import queries as finance_queries
58	from app.modules.finance.constants import DocumentType
59	from app.modules.finance.payables_schemas import VendorBillCreate, VendorBillLineCreate
60	from app.modules.finance.schemas import JournalEntryCreate, JournalLineCreate
61	from app.modules.finance.service.journal import create_draft_entry, post_entry
62	from app.modules.finance.service.vendor_bills import create_vendor_bill, post_vendor_bill
63	from app.modules.inventory.constants import DEFAULT_COSTING_CURRENCY, STOCK_MOVE_POSTS_LINK
64	from app.modules.inventory.events import StockValued
65	from app.modules.procurement.constants import INVOICE_MATCH_BILLED_BY_BILL_LINK
66	from app.modules.procurement.events import InvoiceMatched
67	
68	# A signed posting: (account_id, amount). Positive amount => debit, negative => credit. The line
69	# builder drops zeros and splits into the journal's one-sided debit/credit lines.
70	_SignedPosting = tuple[uuid.UUID, Decimal]
71	
72	
73	async def post_stock_valuation_journal(session: AsyncSession, event: StockValued) -> None:
74	    """Post the COGS/inventory journal for a valued stock move (D-020), in the move's transaction.
75	
76	    Registered via ``app.main.register_event_handlers`` (the deterministic D-011 registration seam),
77	    not an import-time ``@on`` decorator, so the test harness can re-register it after its per-test
78	    ``clear_subscriptions`` reset (D-025) without relying on a module re-import.
79	
80	    Builds the signed postings for the move type, turns them into balanced one-sided journal lines,
81	    posts a COGS-typed entry dated the move date (the period trigger fires here — a closed period
82	    rolls the whole move back), and links move.document -> entry.document ('posts')."""
83	    currency_code = (
84	        await finance_queries.functional_currency_or_none(session, event.tenant_id)
85	        or DEFAULT_COSTING_CURRENCY
86	    )
87	    # total_cost is already quantized for ISSUE (per-layer / MAV quantize) but a RECEIPT's
88	    # qty × unit_cost can carry sub-currency digits — quantize the posted amount at the boundary
89	    # (D-015); the residual flush is already an exact MoneyType difference.
90	    amount = quantize_for_currency(Decimal(event.total_cost), currency_code)
91	    residual = Decimal(event.residual_to_price_difference)
92	
93	    postings = _postings_for(event, amount, residual)
94	    lines = _lines_from_postings(postings, event.item_id)
95	    if len(lines) < 2:
96	        # A zero-value move (e.g. a free receipt) produces no balanced entry — nothing to post. The
97	        # quant/valuation still updated; there is simply no GL effect. (Not reachable on priced
98	        # moves.)
99	        return
100	
101	    entry = await create_draft_entry(
102	        session,
103	        event.tenant_id,
104	        JournalEntryCreate(
105	            posting_date=date.fromisoformat(event.move_date),
106	            currency_code=currency_code,
107	            description=f"Stock {event.move_type.lower()} {event.move_number}",
108	            document_type=DocumentType.COGS,
109	            lines=lines,
110	        ),
111	    )
112	    await post_entry(session, event.tenant_id, entry.id)
113	    # Link the move's document to the journal entry's document so the docflow chain shows the COGS
114	    # posting (D-012 'posts' edge — the finance posting convention).
115	    await docflow.link_documents(
116	        session,
117	        event.tenant_id,
118	        predecessor=event.document_id,
119	        successor=entry.document_id,
120	        link_type=STOCK_MOVE_POSTS_LINK,
121	    )
122	
123	
124	def _postings_for(
125	    event: StockValued, amount: Decimal, residual: Decimal
126	) -> list[_SignedPosting]:
127	    """The signed GL postings (positive = debit, negative = credit) for the move (D-020).
128	
129	    The costing engine already chose ``offset_account_id`` per move type (ISSUE -> COGS; RECEIPT /
130	    ADJUSTMENT -> price-difference; a reversal -> the opposite of the original's offset), so the
131	    handler stays a thin Dr/Cr direction switch:
132	    - inbound: Dr inventory / Cr offset (stock entered or an issue was reversed).
133	    - outbound: Dr offset / Cr inventory (stock left or a receipt was reversed). The inventory leg
134	      additionally carries the moving-average zero-quantity residual, flushed to price-difference,
135	      so value and quantity reconcile to zero (D-020). ``residual`` is 0 unless the issue drove
136	      on-hand to exactly zero."""
137	    if event.is_inbound:
138	        return [
139	            (event.inventory_account_id, amount),
140	            (event.offset_account_id, -amount),
141	        ]
142	    return [
143	        (event.offset_account_id, amount),
144	        (event.inventory_account_id, -(amount + residual)),
145	        (event.price_difference_account_id, residual),
146	    ]
147	
148	
149	def _lines_from_postings(
150	    postings: list[_SignedPosting], item_id: uuid.UUID
151	) -> list[JournalLineCreate]:
152	    """Collapse signed postings per account, drop zeros, and emit one-sided journal lines (D-017):
153	    a positive net is a debit, a negative net a credit. The item dimension rides every line so the
154	    COGS entry is attributable to the item (D-017 dimensions)."""
155	    net: dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal] = {}
156	    for account_id, signed in postings:
157	        net[account_id] = net.get(account_id, Decimal(0)) + signed
158	    lines: list[JournalLineCreate] = []
159	    for account_id, value in net.items():
160	        if value == 0:
161	            continue
162	        if value > 0:
163	            lines.append(
164	                JournalLineCreate(
165	                    account_id=account_id,
166	                    transaction_debit_amount=value,
167	                    item_id=item_id,
168	                )
169	            )
170	        else:
171	            lines.append(
172	                JournalLineCreate(
173	                    account_id=account_id,
174	                    transaction_credit_amount=-value,
175	                    item_id=item_id,
176	                )
177	            )
178	    return lines
179	
180	
181	async def create_bill_for_match(session: AsyncSession, event: InvoiceMatched) -> None:
182	    """Create + post the AP vendor bill for a posted 3-way match (PLAN 6.4, D-042), in the match's
183	    transaction.
184	
185	    Builds a draft vendor bill whose lines DEBIT GR/IR at PO cost and route the in-tolerance price
186	    difference to the purchase-price-variance account, with the header tax code driving input tax,
187	    then posts it through the finance AP service (``create_vendor_bill`` + ``post_vendor_bill``) so
188	    every AP/journal invariant fires exactly as for a hand-entered bill. The AP control is credited
189	    at the vendor-invoiced gross, partner-keyed by the opaque vendor id (D-029); the bill's due date
190	    is invoice_date + the vendor's terms (procurement computed it). The GR/IR debit equals the GR/IR
191	    credit at receipt, so GR/IR nets to zero — the procure-to-pay loop closes. Linking the match
192	    document to the bill document ('billed_by') completes the PO → GR → match → bill docflow chain.
193	
194	    Registered via ``app.main.register_event_handlers`` (the deterministic D-011 seam), so the test
195	    harness re-registers it after its per-test ``clear_subscriptions`` reset (D-025)."""
196	    lines: list[VendorBillLineCreate] = []
197	    for line in event.lines:
198	        # The GR/IR clearing portion at PO cost (taxable): Dr GR/IR, clearing the receipt credit.
199	        lines.append(
200	            VendorBillLineCreate(
201	                account_id=event.gr_ir_account_id,
202	                description="GR/IR clearing",
203	                net_amount=line.gr_ir_amount,
204	                tax_code_id=event.tax_code_id,
205	            )
206	        )
207	        # The price variance (taxable, same code so input tax matches the full invoice): Dr/Cr PPV.
208	        # Dropped when zero so a clean match posts no PPV line.
209	        if line.price_variance != 0:
210	            lines.append(
211	                VendorBillLineCreate(
212	                    account_id=event.ppv_account_id,
213	                    description="Purchase price variance",
214	                    net_amount=line.price_variance,
215	                    tax_code_id=event.tax_code_id,
216	                )
217	            )
218	
219	    bill = await create_vendor_bill(
220	        session,
221	        event.tenant_id,
222	        VendorBillCreate(
223	            partner_id=event.partner_id,
224	            partner_name=event.partner_name,
225	            bill_date=event.invoice_date,
226	            due_date=event.due_date,
227	            currency_code=event.currency_code,
228	            ap_account_id=event.ap_account_id,
229	            bill_external_ref=event.vendor_invoice_ref,
230	            description=f"3-way match {event.match_number}",
231	            lines=lines,
232	        ),
233	    )
234	    await post_vendor_bill(session, event.tenant_id, bill.id, posting_date=event.invoice_date)
235	    await docflow.link_documents(
236	        session,
237	        event.tenant_id,
238	        predecessor=event.document_id,
239	        successor=bill.document_id,
240	        link_type=INVOICE_MATCH_BILLED_BY_BILL_LINK,
241	    )
242	
243	
244	__all__ = ["create_bill_for_match", "post_stock_valuation_journal"]

1	"""Accounts Receivable: customer invoices, receipts, allocations and dunning (PLAN 4.6, D-029).
2	
3	The AR sub-ledger mirrors AP (``payables.py``) with the sign flipped: a posted invoice debits the
4	AR control for the gross and credits revenue + output tax (vs AP's Dr expense / Cr AP); a receipt
5	credits AR control and debits the bank (vs AP's Dr AP / Cr bank). Like AP it is keyed by an OPAQUE
6	``partner_id`` (D-029): finance is the bottom of the dependency order, so it never FK-references a
7	customer master (that lives in sales, above finance). Each AR document carries the opaque
8	``partner_id`` plus a denormalized ``partner_name`` for display; the owning module guarantees it.
9	
10	AR adds DUNNING: each open invoice tracks how many dunning notices have been sent
11	(``dunning_level``) and when (``last_dunned_date``). The dunning run (service/dunning.py) advances
12	those as the invoice ages past the day-thresholds; it posts no journal — it only updates state.
13	
14	Every AR document posts through the universal journal (D-017): a ``CustomerInvoice`` registers in
15	core_documents at creation (DocumentMixin) and gets a ``journal_entry_id`` + system number at
16	posting; a ``CustomerReceipt`` is created and posted in one step, clearing the open items its
17	allocations name. Realized FX at clearing (D-019) is computed in the SERVICE, posted inside the
18	receipt journal entry — no extra columns here.
19	
20	Sixth file in the finance ``models/`` package (STRUCTURE §3); re-exported from ``models/__init__``.
21	Money columns use ``MoneyType`` (D-015, exact on both engines). All cross-row links are composite
22	tenant FKs (D-007 backstop) EXCEPT ``partner_id`` (opaque, no FK — D-029) and the dimension ids.
23	Enum-valued columns are plain ``sa.String`` storing the StrEnum value, as elsewhere in finance.
24	"""
25	
26	import uuid
27	from datetime import date
28	
29	import sqlalchemy as sa
30	from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

46	class CustomerInvoice(UuidPKMixin, TenantMixin, AuditMixin, TimestampMixin, DocumentMixin, Base):

48	    doc_number NULL); the gapless system ``invoice_number`` is claimed at POSTING (D-012).
49	    ``partner_id`` is the OPAQUE customer id (D-029 — no FK); ``partner_name`` is the denormalized
50	    display name. ``external_ref`` is the tenant's own reference (free text, not unique). At posting
51	    the service builds the AR journal entry (Dr AR control gross, Cr each revenue line net, Cr
52	    output tax), sets ``journal_entry_id`` + ``open_amount`` = gross, flips ``status`` to POSTED.
53	    ``open_amount`` (transaction currency) is the still-owed balance, reduced by receipt allocations
54	    until PAID. ``dunning_level`` is how many dunning notices have been sent (0 = none); the dunning
55	    run raises it as the invoice ages and stamps ``last_dunned_date``. Audited (D-010)."""
56	
57	    __tablename__ = "fin_customer_invoices"
58	    __table_args__ = (
59	        tenant_unique(),
60	        tenant_fk("adm_tenants"),
61	        document_fk(),

63	        # AR control account so the sub-ledger needs no fixed default (D-029).

70	            "ix_fin_customer_invoices_list_filters",

72	            "partner_id",
73	            "status",
74	            "invoice_date",

78	    partner_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
79	    partner_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(sa.String(200), nullable=False)
80	    # The tenant's own reference on the invoice (free text, not the system number); nullable.
81	    external_ref: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(sa.String(60), nullable=True)
82	    # The gapless system number, claimed at posting (NULL until then; D-012).

89	    )

97	    )

99	        MoneyType(), nullable=False, default=0, server_default="0"
100	    )
101	    # Still-owed balance in the invoice's transaction currency. Equals gross at posting; reduced by
102	    # receipt allocations until 0 (PAID). No stored total elsewhere — aging projects over this.
103	    open_amount: Mapped[object] = mapped_column(
104	        MoneyType(), nullable=False, default=0, server_default="0"
105	    )
106	    # How many dunning notices have been sent (0 = none); raised by the dunning run as the invoice
107	    # ages past the day-thresholds. ``last_dunned_date`` records the most recent advancing run.
108	    dunning_level: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
109	        sa.Integer, nullable=False, default=0, server_default="0"
110	    )
111	    last_dunned_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(sa.Date, nullable=True)
112	    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(sa.String(500), nullable=True)

155	    journal entry (Cr AR control for the sum cleared, Dr bank for ``amount``, plus a realized-FX

215	            name="fk_fin_cust_receipt_allocs_tenant_id_invoices",
216	        ),
217	    )

219	    receipt_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
220	    customer_invoice_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)

1	"""Customer-invoice lifecycle: draft creation + posting through the journal (PLAN 4.6, AR).
2	
3	The AP ``vendor_bills.py`` mirror with the sign flipped. ``create_customer_invoice`` computes the
4	output tax (via the shared tax engine) and totals on a DRAFT; ``post_customer_invoice`` builds and
5	posts the AR journal entry (Dr the AR control for the gross — with the opaque ``partner_id`` stamped
6	on the AR line, D-029 — Cr each revenue line net, Cr output tax to the tax code's payable account),
7	claims the gapless system number (D-012), links the invoice document to its journal entry (docflow),
8	sets ``open_amount`` = gross, and publishes ``CustomerInvoicePosted``. Idempotent at the service
9	level: a re-post of an already-POSTED invoice returns it unchanged.
10	
11	The journal engine handles FX translation at posting (D-019): a foreign-currency invoice's
12	functional amounts are frozen at the posting-date SPOT rate by the same machinery every entry uses.
13	Finance stays the bottom dependency — this module imports no other module.
14	"""
15	
16	from __future__ import annotations
17	
18	import uuid
19	from datetime import date
20	from decimal import Decimal
21	
22	from sqlalchemy import select
23	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
24	
25	from app.core import docflow
26	from app.core.events import publish
27	from app.core.exceptions import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
28	from app.core.money import quantize_for_currency
29	from app.core.numbering import claim_number, ensure_sequence
30	from app.modules.finance.constants import (
31	    AR_INVOICE_DOC_TYPE,
32	    AR_INVOICE_NUMBER_PADDING,
33	    AR_INVOICE_NUMBER_PREFIX,
34	    AR_INVOICE_POSTS_LINK,
35	    AR_INVOICE_SEQUENCE_NAME,
36	    AR_PARTNER_TYPE,
37	    DocumentType,
38	    InvoiceStatus,
39	    TaxDirection,
40	)
41	from app.modules.finance.events import CustomerInvoicePosted
42	from app.modules.finance.models import (
43	    Account,
44	    CustomerInvoice,
45	    CustomerInvoiceLine,
46	    TaxCode,
47	)
48	from app.modules.finance.receivables_schemas import CustomerInvoiceCreate
49	from app.modules.finance.schemas import JournalEntryCreate, JournalLineCreate
50	from app.modules.finance.service.journal import create_draft_entry, post_entry
51	from app.modules.finance.service.tax import calculate_line_tax
52	
53	
54	async def _require_account(
55	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, account_id: uuid.UUID, *, label: str
56	) -> Account:
57	    account = (
58	        await session.execute(
59	            select(Account).where(Account.tenant_id == tenant_id, Account.id == account_id)
60	        )
61	    ).scalar_one_or_none()
62	    if account is None:
63	        raise ValidationFailedError(
64	            message=f"The {label} account does not exist in this tenant",
65	            code="finance.ar_account_not_found",
66	            details={"account_id": str(account_id)},
67	        )
68	    return account
69	
70	
71	async def _tax_code(
72	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, tax_code_id: uuid.UUID
73	) -> TaxCode:
74	    tax_code = (
75	        await session.execute(
76	            select(TaxCode).where(TaxCode.tenant_id == tenant_id, TaxCode.id == tax_code_id)
77	        )
78	    ).scalar_one_or_none()
79	    if tax_code is None:
80	        raise ValidationFailedError(
81	            message="A line references an unknown tax code",
82	            code="finance.ar_tax_code_not_found",
83	            details={"tax_code_id": str(tax_code_id)},
84	        )
85	    return tax_code
86	
87	
88	async def get_customer_invoice(
89	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, invoice_id: uuid.UUID
90	) -> CustomerInvoice:
91	    invoice = await session.get(CustomerInvoice, invoice_id)
92	    if invoice is None or invoice.tenant_id != tenant_id:
93	        raise NotFoundError(
94	            message="Customer invoice not found", code="finance.customer_invoice_not_found"
95	        )
96	    return invoice
97	
98	
99	async def get_customer_invoice_lines(
100	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, invoice_id: uuid.UUID
101	) -> list[CustomerInvoiceLine]:
102	    stmt = (
103	        select(CustomerInvoiceLine)
104	        .where(
105	            CustomerInvoiceLine.tenant_id == tenant_id,
106	            CustomerInvoiceLine.invoice_id == invoice_id,
107	        )
108	        .order_by(CustomerInvoiceLine.line_number)
109	    )
110	    return list((await session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
111	
112	
113	async def create_customer_invoice(
114	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, payload: CustomerInvoiceCreate
115	) -> CustomerInvoice:
116	    """Create a DRAFT customer invoice + lines (PLAN 4.6). Validates the AR control + every line
117	    account exists; computes output tax per line via the shared tax engine (so net/tax/gross match
118	    AP) and rolls up the invoice totals. Registers the document in core_documents with NO number
119	    (claimed at posting, D-012). ``open_amount`` stays 0 until posting. Does NOT post a journal."""
120	    if not payload.lines:
121	        raise ValidationFailedError(
122	            message="A customer invoice needs at least one line",
123	            code="finance.customer_invoice_no_lines",
124	        )
125	    await _require_account(session, tenant_id, payload.ar_account_id, label="AR control")
126	
127	    gross_total = Decimal(0)
128	    tax_total = Decimal(0)
129	    net_total = Decimal(0)
130	    line_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
131	    for index, line in enumerate(payload.lines, start=1):
132	        await _require_account(session, tenant_id, line.account_id, label="line")
133	        net = quantize_for_currency(line.net_amount, payload.currency_code)
134	        tax_amount = Decimal(0)
135	        if line.tax_code_id is not None:
136	            tax_code = await _tax_code(session, tenant_id, line.tax_code_id)
137	            calc = calculate_line_tax(
138	                net, tax_code, direction=TaxDirection.OUTPUT, currency_code=payload.currency_code
139	            )
140	            net = calc.net_amount
141	            tax_amount = calc.tax_amount
142	        net_total += net
143	        tax_total += tax_amount
144	        gross_total += net + tax_amount
145	        line_rows.append(
146	            {
147	                "line_number": index,
148	                "account_id": line.account_id,
149	                "description": line.description,
150	                "net_amount": net,
151	                "tax_code_id": line.tax_code_id,
152	                "tax_amount": tax_amount,
153	                "cost_center_id": line.cost_center_id,
154	                "profit_center_id": line.profit_center_id,
155	                "project_id": line.project_id,
156	            }
157	        )
158	
159	    invoice_id = uuid.uuid4()
160	    document = await docflow.register_document(
161	        session,
162	        tenant_id,
163	        AR_INVOICE_DOC_TYPE,
164	        invoice_id,
165	        doc_number=None,
166	        status=InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value,
167	    )
168	    invoice = CustomerInvoice(
169	        id=invoice_id,
170	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
171	        document_id=document.id,
172	        partner_id=payload.partner_id,
173	        partner_name=payload.partner_name,
174	        external_ref=payload.external_ref,
175	        invoice_date=payload.invoice_date,
176	        due_date=payload.due_date,
177	        currency_code=payload.currency_code,
178	        status=InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value,
179	        ar_account_id=payload.ar_account_id,
180	        gross_amount=gross_total,
181	        tax_amount=tax_total,
182	        net_amount=net_total,
183	        open_amount=Decimal(0),
184	        dunning_level=0,
185	        description=payload.description,
186	    )
187	    session.add(invoice)
188	    for row in line_rows:
189	        session.add(CustomerInvoiceLine(tenant_id=tenant_id, invoice_id=invoice_id, **row))
190	    await session.flush()
191	    return invoice
192	
193	
194	def _invoice_journal_lines(
195	    invoice: CustomerInvoice,
196	    lines: list[CustomerInvoiceLine],
197	    tax_account_by_code: dict[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID],
198	) -> list[JournalLineCreate]:
199	    """The balanced AR journal lines for an invoice (PLAN 4.6): Dr the AR control for the gross —
200	    partner_id stamped on the AR line so the open item is partner-keyed (D-029) — Cr each line's net
201	    to its revenue account, Cr output tax to the tax code's payable account (one line per line with
202	    tax). Dimensions ride to the journal line so CO projections see them."""
203	    journal_lines: list[JournalLineCreate] = [
204	        JournalLineCreate(
205	            account_id=invoice.ar_account_id,
206	            description=f"AR {invoice.partner_name}",
207	            transaction_debit_amount=invoice.gross_amount,
208	            partner_type=AR_PARTNER_TYPE,
209	            partner_id=invoice.partner_id,
210	        )
211	    ]
212	    for line in lines:
213	        journal_lines.append(
214	            JournalLineCreate(
215	                account_id=line.account_id,
216	                description=line.description,
217	                transaction_credit_amount=line.net_amount,
218	                cost_center_id=line.cost_center_id,
219	                profit_center_id=line.profit_center_id,
220	                project_id=line.project_id,
221	            )
222	        )
223	        if line.tax_amount and line.tax_code_id is not None:
224	            journal_lines.append(
225	                JournalLineCreate(
226	                    account_id=tax_account_by_code[line.tax_code_id],
227	                    description="Output tax",
228	                    transaction_credit_amount=line.tax_amount,
229	                )
230	            )
231	    return journal_lines
232	
233	
234	async def _resolve_tax_accounts(
235	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, lines: list[CustomerInvoiceLine]
236	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID]:
237	    """Map each line's tax_code_id -> its payable (OUTPUT) account (PLAN 4.6). Raises a clear 422 if
238	    a code that levied tax has no payable account wired (the tax engine would otherwise post to
239	    None)."""
240	    accounts: dict[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID] = {}
241	    for line in lines:
242	        if not line.tax_amount or line.tax_code_id is None or line.tax_code_id in accounts:
243	            continue
244	        tax_code = await _tax_code(session, tenant_id, line.tax_code_id)
245	        if tax_code.tax_payable_account_id is None:
246	            raise ValidationFailedError(
247	                message=f"Tax code {tax_code.code} has no output-tax (payable) account",
248	                code="finance.ar_tax_account_unwired",
249	                details={"tax_code_id": str(line.tax_code_id)},
250	            )
251	        accounts[line.tax_code_id] = tax_code.tax_payable_account_id
252	    return accounts
253	
254	
255	async def post_customer_invoice(
256	    session: AsyncSession,
257	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
258	    invoice_id: uuid.UUID,
259	    *,
260	    posting_date: date | None = None,
261	) -> CustomerInvoice:
262	    """Post a DRAFT customer invoice to the journal (PLAN 4.6). Idempotent: an already-POSTED
263	    invoice is returned unchanged. Builds the balanced AR entry (document_type AR_INVOICE), posts it
264	    via the journal engine (which claims the entry number, resolves the period, and translates FX at
265	    the posting rate, D-019), claims the invoice's gapless system number, links invoice->journal
266	    (docflow 'posts'), sets ``open_amount`` = gross + status POSTED, and publishes
267	    ``CustomerInvoicePosted``. ``posting_date`` defaults to the invoice date."""
268	    invoice = await get_customer_invoice(session, tenant_id, invoice_id)
269	    if invoice.status == InvoiceStatus.POSTED.value:
270	        return invoice
271	    if invoice.status != InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value:
272	        raise ConflictError(
273	            message="Only a draft customer invoice can be posted",
274	            code="finance.customer_invoice_not_draft",
275	            details={"status": invoice.status},
276	        )
277	
278	    lines = await get_customer_invoice_lines(session, tenant_id, invoice_id)
279	    tax_account_by_code = await _resolve_tax_accounts(session, tenant_id, lines)
280	
281	    entry = await create_draft_entry(
282	        session,
283	        tenant_id,
284	        JournalEntryCreate(
285	            posting_date=posting_date or invoice.invoice_date,
286	            currency_code=invoice.currency_code,
287	            description=f"Customer invoice {invoice.partner_name}",
288	            document_type=DocumentType.AR_INVOICE,
289	            lines=_invoice_journal_lines(invoice, lines, tax_account_by_code),
290	        ),
291	    )
292	    await post_entry(session, tenant_id, entry.id)
293	
294	    await ensure_sequence(
295	        session,
296	        tenant_id,
297	        AR_INVOICE_SEQUENCE_NAME,
298	        AR_INVOICE_NUMBER_PREFIX,
299	        AR_INVOICE_NUMBER_PADDING,
300	        year_reset=True,
301	    )
302	    invoice_number = await claim_number(
303	        session, tenant_id, AR_INVOICE_SEQUENCE_NAME, on_date=invoice.invoice_date
304	    )
305	
306	    invoice.invoice_number = invoice_number
307	    invoice.journal_entry_id = entry.id
308	    invoice.open_amount = invoice.gross_amount
309	    invoice.status = InvoiceStatus.POSTED.value
310	    await session.flush()
311	
312	    await docflow.set_document_status(
313	        session,
314	        tenant_id,
315	        invoice.document_id,
316	        status=InvoiceStatus.POSTED.value,
317	        doc_number=invoice_number,
318	    )
319	    await docflow.link_documents(
320	        session,
321	        tenant_id,
322	        predecessor=invoice.document_id,
323	        successor=entry.document_id,
324	        link_type=AR_INVOICE_POSTS_LINK,
325	    )
326	
327	    publish(
328	        session,
329	        CustomerInvoicePosted(
330	            tenant_id=tenant_id,
331	            invoice_id=invoice.id,
332	            invoice_number=invoice_number,
333	            journal_entry_id=entry.id,
334	            partner_id=invoice.partner_id,
335	            currency_code=invoice.currency_code,
336	            gross_amount=invoice.gross_amount,
337	            tax_amount=invoice.tax_amount,
338	            net_amount=invoice.net_amount,
339	        ),
340	    )
341	    return invoice
342	
343	
344	async def list_customer_invoices(
345	    session: AsyncSession,
346	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
347	    *,
348	    cursor: str | None,
349	    limit: int,
350	    status: str | None = None,
351	    partner_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
352	) -> object:
353	    """Keyset-paginated invoice list, newest invoice_date first (D-014). ``status`` + ``partner_id``
354	    filters fold into the cursor fingerprint. Returns a ``Page`` of ORM objects."""
355	    from app.core.pagination import OrderKey, SortDirection, filter_fingerprint, paginate
356	
357	    stmt = select(CustomerInvoice).where(CustomerInvoice.tenant_id == tenant_id)
358	    if status is not None:
359	        stmt = stmt.where(CustomerInvoice.status == InvoiceStatus(status).value)
360	    if partner_id is not None:
361	        stmt = stmt.where(CustomerInvoice.partner_id == partner_id)
362	    return await paginate(
363	        session,
364	        stmt,
365	        order_by=[
366	            OrderKey(CustomerInvoice.invoice_date, SortDirection.DESC),
367	            OrderKey(CustomerInvoice.created_at, SortDirection.DESC),
368	        ],
369	        pk=CustomerInvoice.id,
370	        cursor=cursor,
371	        limit=limit,
372	        filters=filter_fingerprint(status, partner_id),
373	    )
374
